design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (hospital_account_billing, env_0073). Frozen 2026-09-10 14:05:00 CDT. Rework rounds 2-6 (audit revision_1 C1..C9, revision_2 C1', C2', C3', C10-C15, render round 1 Mismatch 1, Notes 2-3, revision_4 C16, and KB audit src-1/src-2 closed; see worklog).

1. WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. Kevin Brandt asks only to pay his July 2-4 emergency/observation stay at Appleton off in full today. His Network Health HMO coverage had ended 2026-06-30; the claim was denied PR-27 on 2026-07-22, the financial class was corrected to SELF_PAY and the 9824.00 posted as COVERAGE_TERMINATED, but no uninsured discount was posted on it and two summary statements (07-30, 08-29) went out at the undiscounted figure. The self-pay payoff rule waits on the service-recovery courtesy owed for those misstated statements; the courtesy waits on the coverage-loss discount and on the self-pay observation-rate discount of the 52-hour observation line. A solver must derive the tree from the rules and the ledger, post three adjustments in a valid order, then hand him the payoff tool.

2. SCOPE SNAPSHOT. Draw: {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 4, 4, 6]}. Claims encounter_ext_terminated_coverage_discount (5), encounter_ext_observation_rate_discount (4), encounter_ext_service_recovery_courtesy (4), encounter_ext_selfpay_payoff (6) and tools post_terminated_coverage_discount_f939a41d, post_observation_rate_discount_cc1ec28d, post_service_recovery_courtesy_69e36558 (agent) + pay_self_pay_balance_in_full_3917aa11 (user). Disjoint from task 0.

3. PROBLEM TREE CARD (C1/C2/C9 and C1'/C2'/C3'/C12/C14 closed: every sentence and its condition name the same waited-on state, each false at opening under its own condition, each satisfiable whenever it applies, sources unique by a stated tie rule).
 Root encounter_ext_selfpay_payoff. Edge root -> encounter_ext_service_recovery_courtesy (value_input, gate sp_balance, state form): "The self-pay payoff amount is fixed only after a self-pay account that carries coverage-terminated liability postings, and whose first summary statement went out before any of them carried an uninsured discount, carries the service-recovery courtesy owed for that, unless the patient's courtesy for the calendar year was already used or the account's patient balance is 0.00 or less." Condition: SELF_PAY account with COVERAGE_TERMINATED postings whose earliest SUMMARY_STATEMENT predates the first UNINSURED_DISCOUNT sourced to such a posting (or none stands) -> a SERVICE_RECOVERY_COURTESY stands sourced to one of its COVERAGE_TERMINATED postings, unless a courtesy already stands for the patient in that calendar year or patient_balance is 0.00 or less. At opening: summaries 07-30 and 08-29, no discount, no 2026 courtesy, balance 9474.00 -> unmet. C3': a zero or credit balance is carved out by record test and the courtesy rule owes nothing there (ceiling never below 0.00).
 Edge courtesy -> encounter_ext_terminated_coverage_discount (state): "On a self-pay account that carries coverage-terminated liability postings, the courtesy is not fixed until an uninsured discount stands against one of those postings." Unmet: the 2026-08-05 discount names the 07-10 visit's posting. C2': the depended-on rule posts one adjustment per account (sourced to the most recent posting, first recorded on a same-day tie) and a later posting does not reopen it, so the wait once met stays met. The figure is positive (COVERAGE_TERMINATED amounts are positive, starting percent above 0).
 Edge courtesy -> encounter_ext_observation_rate_discount (state): "On a self-pay account whose stay has ended and whose final bill has dropped, that carries observation-hour charge lines and that is not priced under a self-pay package, the courtesy is not fixed until an observation-rate discount stands against one of those lines." Unmet: one 0762 line of 52 units, no discount names it, no PACKAGE_PRICE_ADJUSTMENT, final_bill_date 2026-07-08 and service_end_date 2026-07-04 recorded. C16: an open or not yet final-billed stay is outside the observation rule (base: the uninsured discount follows the final bill) and carved out of the wait by the same record test. C1': the observation-rate discount is never below obs_floor_pct (5%) of the observation-hour charges, so it is positive whenever the wait applies; C14: package accounts are outside the rule and carved out of the wait by record test.
 Order: {coverage-loss discount, observation-rate discount} (commute: order ob, td gives the same four numbers) -> courtesy -> payoff. Deletion (run): skip coverage-loss -> courtesy 50.00 (error 487.00 below 500 -> standard 15.00), payoff 7027.89; skip observation -> courtesy 69.41, payoff 1977.17; skip courtesy -> payoff 1648.32; gold 6881.20 / 487.00 / 71.84 / 1591.74.
 Resolving-write uniqueness: COVERAGE_TERMINATED-sourced UNINSURED_DISCOUNT rows only by the coverage-loss rule; 0762-sourced only by the observation rule; SERVICE_RECOVERY_COURTESY sourced to a COVERAGE_TERMINATED posting only by the courtesy rule (source: the most recent such posting, first recorded on a same-day tie; C12).
  Round 6 (src-2, scope sweep): each of the three sentences now opens with the scope its condition carries, by the same record test (self-pay account with coverage-terminated postings; self-pay account whose stay has ended and whose final bill has dropped, with observation-hour lines and no package price; self-pay account with coverage-terminated postings whose first summary predates any discount on them). The discretionary courtesy on every other account is therefore outside both courtesy waits in the words, as in the conditions.
 Customer write: the payoff payment (owner=user), by debit card over the phone. no_user_hint: persona never mentions a discount, the observation rate or a courtesy.

4. FACTOR CARD — encounter_ext_terminated_coverage_discount (baseline: uninsured_discount_pct 50.0 of the COVERAGE_TERMINATED total 9824.00 = 4912.00; result 6881.20 = MN(9824.00, RND(9824.00 x 67.5 / 100, 2) + 250.00)). Real levers: patient class (EMERGENCY arrival), size of the loss, the current assistance determination, the catastrophic-expense cap of a FAP (liability capped at a share of documented income), CARC PR-27.
 arrival_through_emergency (parameter, multi-source: service_classification EMERGENCY AND an 0450 ED line) -> +5.0; this factor at baseline gives 6390.00.
 coverage_loss_band (parameter): 9824.00 at least large_loss_usd 7500 -> +5.0; 6390.00.
 coverage_loss_near_eligibility (parameter, cross-difficulty assist): the patient's most recent assistance determination (only cases in approved, denied, expired or revoked status are determinations (a submitted, pending_documents or withdrawn case is never read, whatever its date; Note 3), latest determination_date, an award dated the same day as a denial counts as later, first recorded of two same-day denials; C10) is the hardship-tier denial INCOME_ABOVE_LIMIT of 2026-01-22, 231 days before (within 365) -> +5.0; 6390.00. Seeded case: 2025 HHS guideline household 1 $15,650; income 66513.00 = 425% FPL.
 catastrophic_share (method, cross-difficulty assist): income documented on the most recent determination when that determination is a denial (same status-filtered selection; an award, expiry or revocation as the latest determination gives no credit; round 4): 9824.00 / 66513.00 = 14.8%, at least catastrophic_flat_pct 10, below catastrophic_cap_pct 20 -> flat 250.00; 6631.20.
 other_coverage_losses (parameter, cross-difficulty claim): PR-27 releases on the patient's claims other than the one the most recent COVERAGE_TERMINATED posting names: one (the 07-10 visit) -> +2.5; 6635.60. Absent claim reference: every PR-27 release counts (rule sentence; probed in round 2).
 Method all-pairs table (catastrophic_share, unchanged shape): cap tier vs flat — the cap tier reads amount, starting percent and income (MX(250, amount x (1 - 0.50) - 20% of income); amount 20000 on income 50000 -> 10000.00, flat stays 250.00); cap vs none — cap at least 250 on its whole domain; flat vs none — 250.00 vs 0.

5. FACTOR CARD — encounter_ext_observation_rate_discount (baseline: day rate 1250 x plain days 2 = 2500; (4784.00 - 2500) x (1 - 0.50) = 1142.00, above the 5% floor 239.20; result 487.00 = MN(4784.00, MX(239.20, RND(MX(0, 4784.00 - 1350 x 3) x 0.50, 2)) + 120.00)). Scope (C14, C16): SELF_PAY accounts with 0762 lines, final_bill_date and service_end_date recorded (final bill dropped), and no PACKAGE_PRICE_ADJUSTMENT (base: a package account never receives the uninsured discount); overwrite restatements name the same scope. Floor (C1'): never less than obs_floor_pct 5% of the observation-hour charges, held before the flat carve-out is added.
 campus_day_rate (parameter, multi-source: facility AND an 0450 ED line — observation placed through the emergency department; a direct or post-procedure placement takes none, so the conjunct discriminates; C11): Appleton -> +250 per day; 862.00.
 observation_day_count (method, multi-source): stay crossing at least one midnight AND an ED line AND 52 hours above 24 x 2 -> ceil(52 / 24) = 3 days; 1162.00. Tiers now disjoint (C13): tier 1 requires service_end_date after service_start_date, tier 2 is the same-day stay with its service_end_date recorded; an open stay is outside the rule's scope since round 5 (C16), so every priced stay has a recorded end date (the round-4 compute guard on the same-day tier stays and agrees with the rule).
 long_stay_rate (parameter): 52 hours at least 48 -> -150 per day; 359.20 (with the factor at baseline the core figure 142.00 falls under the floor 239.20, which binds).
 procedure_carveout (parameter): 0350 and 0480 lines (2) -> 120.00; 367.00. Tiers read the procedure-line count only (C11 conjunct removed); 0, 1 and 2+ lines are all reachable on observation accounts.
 Method all-pairs table (observation_day_count): hours tier vs same-day — hours tier reads units and needs a midnight (52 h over 2 days -> 3; 30 h over 1 day -> 2), same-day is constant 1; hours vs plain — plain reads the two dates only (52 h over 2 days: 3 vs 2); same-day vs plain — a same-day stay has plain difference 0 vs 1. No input satisfies two tiers.

6. FACTOR CARD — encounter_ext_service_recovery_courtesy (baseline: standard courtesy = standard_courtesy_share 0.2 of the Observation maximum 75.00 = 15.00; result 71.84 = MN(75.00, balance, 36.84 + 10.00 + 10.00 + 15.00)). C3': the ceiling is never below 0.00 and a zero or credit balance is owed no courtesy (probed). C12: source = the most recent COVERAGE_TERMINATED posting, first recorded on a same-day tie.
 corrected_error_size (method; re-cut, C15): UNINSURED_DISCOUNT total on the account 7368.20 at least large_error_usd 5000 -> 0.5% = 36.84; 50.00. Tiers: at least 5000 proportional; 500 to below 5000 flat mid_error_courtesy_usd 25.00; below 500 the standard courtesy. Every tier is reachable on an owed account (the 07-10-type clinic account: error 127.30 -> standard; an imaging-size error 900 -> flat; this stay -> proportional).
 error_duration (parameter, date): first statement 2026-07-30 to 2026-09-10 = 42 days, above 30 -> 10.00; 61.84.
 misstated_statements (parameter; re-cut, C15): an owed account always has at least one summary, so the starting amount answers for the first; exactly two -> 10.00 (taken: 07-30, 08-29), three or more -> 15.00, a single statement -> none; 61.84.
 hold_and_dispute (parameter, multi-source: holds_used_count AND a CHARGE_DISPUTE inquiry on the account) -> 15.00; 56.84.
 Method all-pairs table (corrected_error_size): proportional vs flat — proportional reads the error (7368.20 -> 36.84; 9000 -> 45.00; flat stays 25.00); proportional vs standard — standard reads the account type's maximum, no error input (Observation 15.00, Clinic 5.00); flat vs standard — 25.00 vs 15.00. Monotone at the joins (0.5% of 5000 = 25.00).

7. FACTOR CARD — encounter_ext_selfpay_payoff (baseline: balance 2033.96 after the three postings less prompt_pay_discount_pct 15.0 = 1728.87; result 1591.74 = MX(0, 2033.96 - RND(2033.96 x 21.25 / 100, 2) - 10.00)).
 gross_standing_band (parameter): gross 9824.00 at least 7500 -> +3.0; 1652.76.
 statement_recency (parameter, date): latest summary 2026-08-29, 12 days (above 7, within 14) -> +1.0; 1612.08.
 window_days_left (method, date): 45-day window from 2026-07-30, day 42 -> 3 days left, fewer than 10 -> flat 10.00; 1601.74.
 self_pay_e_statement (parameter): latest summary (first recorded on a same-day tie) by EMAIL_LINK -> +0.5; 1601.91.
 registration_payment (parameter): POINT_OF_SERVICE 100.00 below 250 -> +0.75; 1607.00.
 standing_balance_band (parameter, replaces collection_stage struck under C15): ledger balance = liabilities 9824.00 - adjustments 7440.04 - payments 350.00 + refunds 0.00 = 2033.96, at least 2000 -> +1.0 (500 to below 2000 -> +0.5, below 500 -> none; all reachable inside the window since the Observation prompt-pay minimum is 250); 1612.08.
 Method all-pairs table (window_days_left): linear vs flat — linear reads days left (12 days -> 24.00; 20 -> 40.00; flat stays 10.00); linear vs none — at least 20.00 on its domain; flat vs none — 10.00 vs 0.

8. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Every adjustment write (steps 10, 12, 14) and the payment (step 16) inherits encounter_prompt_pay_discount.prompt_window (anchor first_statement_date 2026-07-30, Observation Stay Account window 45 calendar days from the day after, inclusive; frozen 2026-09-10 is day 42; 2026-09-13 last qualifying), one_prompt_discount (none on the account), small_balance_and_courtesy.courtesy_once_per_year (no courtesy for the patient in 2026; the 07-10 visit's discount was posted 2026-08-05, before its first statement 2026-08-10, so no courtesy is owed there), policy_scope of uninsured_discount (self_pay_class retired by the declared overwrites), charge_dispute (the August dispute was RESOLVED_NO_CHANGE, no credit), coverage_update_rebill (class corrected, no new coverage), and for the payment agg_payment_application and final_bill_and_liability.
 Overwrites (C4): coverage-loss rule — SELF_PAY-at-final-bill gate (names the non-covered and observation sibling cases outside); observation rule — the once-per-SELF_PAY_FINAL_BILL posting sentence (restated verbatim, plus one further discount on 0762 lines only on a final-billed SELF_PAY account not priced under a self-pay package, so base "never the uninsured discount" for package accounts stays in force; C14) and the same gate (names both siblings outside); courtesy rule — the representative-grant sentence (restated in full for every other account: report of a documented failure, cap, balance limit) and the no-combination sentence (restated; only the owed courtesy keeps the prompt-pay discount); self-pay payoff — the prompt-pay amount sentence for SELF_PAY accounts only (the insured sibling excluded by name). Rounding half-up stays in force.

9. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target B0 (Observation Stay Account, Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton, EMERGENCY, 07-02..07-04, gross 9824.00: 0450 1890.00, 0350 1640.00, 0300 204.00, 0258 186.00, 0480 1120.00, 0762 52 units 4784.00; POS 100.00 on 07-02; COVERAGE_TERMINATED 9824.00 on 07-23 from claim D0 (PR-27 release 07-23, denial 07-22, RARC N30); SUMMARY 07-30 US_MAIL and 08-29 EMAIL_LINK; PORTAL_CARD 250.00 on 08-04; CHARGE_DISPUTE on the 0762 line logged 08-06, RESOLVED_NO_CHANGE; holds_used_count 1; balance 9474.00). Excluded: B1 (2025 clinic, closed, copay 30.00 paid 2026-02-03) and B2 (07-10 clinic visit, SELF_PAY, PR-27 on claim DB, COVERAGE_TERMINATED 268.00, UNINSURED_DISCOUNT 127.30 on 08-05 at the Outpatient Clinic tier, summaries 08-10 and 09-09, balance 140.70) — the caller pays only the stay. Assistance case K1: hardship tier, applied 2026-01-08 (portal), household 1, income 66513.00 (425% FPL), denied INCOME_ABOVE_LIMIT 2026-01-22; four ACCEPTED documents and a DENIAL_LETTER.

10. PERSONA. Plain-spoken warehouse shift supervisor; gives name and the goal; DOB and phone on request (ZIP, MRN as alternates); names the visit (emergency visit and observation stay in Appleton, July 2-4, not the follow-up clinic visit) when asked which; mentions the January assistance denial only when asked about assistance; never raises the August dispute; passive "go ahead" to anything that must be posted first; pays the quoted amount with his debit card over the phone.

11. TOOLS DO NOT BLOCK. The three agent tools book any amount against any source row and lower patient_balance; the payoff tool books the payment, posts the remainder as PROMPT_PAY_DISCOUNT and closes the account. None reads adjustments, eligibility or the window. Events: encounter_adjustment_posted, encounter_payment_posted, encounter_closed (base triggers []).

12. STANDARD SOLUTION (17 actions). 0 find_customers -> 1 verify (DOB, phone) -> 2 accounts -> 3 transactions -> 4 billing inquiries -> 5 claims -> 6 claim transactions -> 7 assistance cases -> 8 assistance transactions -> 9/10 coverage-loss discount 6881.20 on <b0_ct> -> 11/12 observation-rate discount 487.00 on <b0_ch7> -> 13/14 courtesy 71.84 on <b0_ct> -> 15/16 patient pays 1591.74 PHONE_CARD. Terminal: B0 closed, balance 0.00; PROMPT_PAY_DISCOUNT 442.22 (= 432.22 + 10.00).

13. PROBE TABLE (scratch copies; result of the affected computation). user_scenario:
You are Kevin Brandt, 42, a warehouse shift supervisor from Neenah, calling Riverbend from your truck before your shift. You are friendly but practical, a little tired of this bill, and you talk in short, plain sentences. You are not an accounts person and you do not pretend to know how hospital billing works.

In early July you went to the emergency room at Riverbend Regional Medical Center in Appleton with chest pain and they kept you for observation until July 4. The latest statement you got, by email at the end of August, shows $9,474.00 due on that stay, and the statement says there is a discount if the account is paid in full within the prompt-pay period. You have the money set aside now and you want to pay that hospital stay off in full today, in one payment, and be done with it. You open by saying you want to pay off your July hospital stay bill today; you give your name, Kevin Brandt, so they can look you up.

You give identifying details only when asked. To confirm who you are you give your date of birth, 1984-02-17, and your phone number, 9205550143. If they want something else, your ZIP code is 54956 and the medical record number on your statement is RB11738205. If they ask which visit, it is the emergency visit and observation stay in Appleton from July 2 to July 4, not the follow-up clinic visit on July 10. If they ask about insurance for that stay, you say you had none in July because your old job's Network Health plan ended June 30. If they ask whether you ever questioned anything on the bill, you say that in August you called to question the observation hours, they put the account on hold to check, and later told you the hours were right. If they ask about payments, you paid $100 at the emergency room desk when you checked in and $250 through the patient portal in early August. If they ask whether you ever applied for financial assistance, you say you applied in January when your hours were cut and were turned down because your income was over the limit.

You do not know what the right payoff figure is and you do not suggest how to get it. If the representative tells you some adjustments or corrections have to be put on the account before they can give you the payoff, you tell them that is fine and to go ahead. When they give you the amount to pay off the account and hand the payment over to you, you pay exactly that amount yourself with your debit card over the phone. If they ask how you want to pay, you say debit card over the phone. You do not argue with the figure they quote; if they explain it, you say okay. You are only calling about the July stay; if they mention the follow-up clinic bill, you say you will take care of that one another time.

When the payment goes through and they tell you the account is paid off, you thank them, say it is a relief to have that behind you, and end the call.

edges.condition: on an account whose financial_class is SELF_PAY, which carries COVERAGE_TERMINATED liability postings and whose earliest SUMMARY_STATEMENT is dated before the first UNINSURED_DISCOUNT sourced to such a posting (or which has no such discount), an encounter_adjustment_posted row with adjustment_code SERVICE_RECOVERY_COURTESY stands sourced to one of the account's COVERAGE_TERMINATED postings, unless a SERVICE_RECOVERY_COURTESY already stands for the patient in the same calendar year on another account or the account's patient_balance is 0.00 or less
edges.policy_source: The self-pay payoff amount is fixed only after a self-pay account that carries coverage-terminated liability postings, and whose first summary statement went out before any of them carried an uninsured discount, carries the service-recovery courtesy owed for that, unless the patient's courtesy for the calendar year was already used or the account's patient balance is 0.00 or less.
